description: This file contains functions for interacting with a Supabase backend, including user authentication, transaction management, alert handling, and data retrieval for insights. It exports multiple asynchronous functions for CRUD operations and data fetching related to transactions and alerts.

methods.name: requireSupabase
methods.description: Ensures a configured Supabase client is available, throws an error if not.

methods.name: getCurrentUserId
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's ID or throws an error if not authenticated.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Fetches transactions for a user, ordered by date and creation time.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Inserts a new transaction record into the database.

methods.name: updateTransaction
methods.description: Updates a transaction identified by its primary key ID.

methods.name: deleteTransaction
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by its primary key ID.

methods.name: listAlerts
methods.description: Fetches alerts for a user, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: dismissAlert
methods.description: Deletes or dismisses an alert by ID.

methods.name: listInsightsSourceTransactions
methods.description: Fetches transactions for insights, optionally filtered by date range.
